description: Shared cross-repo test vector for the plugin-secret seal (ADR-0213, reference/till-user-directives.md plugin-secret section). ut-cloud seals deterministically with the fixed ephemeral key and must reproduce every value below; universal-till opens secret_sealed with the fixed recipient key and must get the plaintext. Suite: RFC 9180 HPKE mode_base, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256) / HKDF-SHA256 / AES-128-GCM, single-shot (sequence 0). Byte values are lowercase hex; info and aad are exact UTF-8 strings (aad fields joined by a single \n: store_external_id, directive_id, type, plugin_id, setting_key); kid is the first 16 hex chars of SHA-256 over the 32 raw recipient public-key bytes; secret_sealed is v1.<kid>.<base64url(enc)>.<base64url(ciphertext)> without padding. plaintext is the exact JSON the cloud seals ({v,ver,value,aux}); ver is monotonic per (store, plugin) and the till refuses a ver at or below its last applied one. Changing any aad field must make the open fail. Test keys only; the value is a made-up string.
